name: Jeberechiah
title: Father of the witness Zechariah
summary: Jeberechiah is a person mentioned in Isaiah 8:2, where he is identified as the father of Zechariah, one of the reliable witnesses the prophet Isaiah called to confirm a prophetic act. He lived in the kingdom of Judah during the time of the prophet Isaiah, under King Ahaz's reign. Although little is known about him personally, his son played an important role as a trustworthy witness in a decisive prophetic event.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as the father of the witness Zechariah
keyEvents.description: Jeberechiah is mentioned as the father of Zechariah, who was called in as a reliable witness when Isaiah was to write the name "Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz" on a large tablet.

keyEvents.title: Prophetic testimony concerning Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz
keyEvents.description: Isaiah took reliable witnesses, including the priest Uriah and Zechariah, son of Jeberechiah, to document the prophecy about the coming Assyrian invasion against Syria and the Northern Kingdom.
